json.notes: Chase Center is a near-circular white arena shell, about 155 m across and 38 m tall, with horizontal band lines on the walls and a broad overhanging roof disc. The south (front) face has a curved full-height glass wall with a projecting canopy, and three polished steel spheres stand on the plaza. I model the white drum, the bronze base band, the stepped roof overhang and cap, the front glass wall and canopy, and the three steel spheres.
